title: Commencement of Mid-Semester Internal Examinations (Sem 3, 5, 7)
summary: Mid-term examinations will commence from 1st August 2026. Hall tickets available for download on student portal.
content: All students of Semester 3, 5, and 7 are hereby notified that the internal mid-term examinations for Academic Year 2026-27 will strictly commence from 1st August 2026 according to the published timetable. Hall tickets will be issued digitally through the student portal starting 25th July. Minimum 75% attendance in theory and laboratory is mandatory to be eligible to sit for the examination.

title: Semester Tuition & Laboratory Fee Payment Deadline Extension
summary: Last date to pay Semester 3 tuition and laboratory fees without late fine has been extended to 31st July 2026.
content: In consideration of requests received from various student representatives, the competent authority has approved an extension of the fee payment deadline to 31st July 2026 (11:59 PM). Late fee penalty of ₹100 per day will be levied on payments received after this date. Online payments can be made via UPI, NetBanking, or Credit Card through the portal.

title: FDSA & OOP Assignment-2 Submission Guidelines & Extension
summary: Submission deadline for Fundamentals of Data Structures & Algorithms Assignment 2 is extended to 20th July.
content: Students of 3rd Semester Computer Engineering Division I & II are notified that Assignment 2 has been updated with extra test cases for AVL Tree and Graph BFS/DFS traversal. The revised submission deadline on the Assignments portal is 20th July 2026. Submissions must adhere to clean code standards and include test suite screenshots.

title: Merit-Cum-Means & State Government Post-Matric Scholarships 2026
summary: Eligible candidates can apply for university merit scholarships and digital Gujarat post-matric scheme.
content: Applications are invited from meritorious and economically weaker students for Academic Year 2026-27 scholarships. Eligible criteria: Minimum CGPA of 8.00 and parental annual income below prescribed thresholds. Application forms with self-attested documents must be submitted to the Student Welfare Section by 15th August 2026.

title: Institutional Holiday Notification - Muharram
summary: The University campus, administrative offices, and academic departments will remain closed on 17th July.
content: As per the official CHARUSAT University Academic Calendar, the University campus and all constituent institutes including CSPIT, DEPSTAR, and RPCP will observe a public holiday on Friday, 17th July 2026. Regular academic lectures and lab sessions will resume on Monday, 20th July 2026 as per the regular timetable.

title: Campus Placement Drive: Microsoft & Oracle Registration Open
summary: Eligible 7th semester students with CGPA >= 7.5 and no active backlogs must register by 30th July.
content: Microsoft and Oracle have announced their joint on-campus recruitment drive for Software Development Engineer (SDE-1) and Cloud Engineer profiles. Package offered: ₹18.5 LPA to ₹24.0 LPA. Online coding assessments will take place in the central computer center on 10th August. Ensure your student portal profile and resume link are updated.

title: Central Library Digital Access & IEEE Xplore Portal Credentials
summary: Remote off-campus access credentials for IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and ACM Digital Library are activated.
content: All registered undergraduate students can now access over 2 million IEEE journals, conference proceedings, and Springer e-books remotely from their home network using Single Sign-On (SSO) credentials. Visit the Library E-Resources tab to configure your OpenAthens university login token.

title: Hostel Wi-Fi Network Upgrade & High-Speed Optical Fiber Maintenance
summary: Scheduled maintenance on campus Wi-Fi access points in Boys & Girls Hostels on Saturday night.
content: To provide gigabit bandwidth for online certifications and academic projects, the IT networking team will be upgrading optical fiber switches and access points across Block A, B, and C on Saturday 29th June between 01:00 AM and 05:00 AM. Intermittent network disruptions may occur during this maintenance window.

title: Selection Trials: Inter-College University Football & Cricket Squad
summary: Open trials for university representative squads will be held at main university sports arena.
content: Interested male and female student athletes wishing to represent CHARUSAT University in the AIU All India Inter-University Tournaments must report at the University Pavilion at 06:30 AM with proper kit and medical fitness certificate. Contact Physical Director Coach Vikram Patel for registration numbers.

title: Mandatory Remedial & Mentorship Sessions for Struggling Students
summary: Extra doubt clearing and remedial classes organized on Friday afternoons for core courses.
content: Faculty mentors have scheduled focused remedial tutorial classes for Discrete Mathematics, FDSA, and Digital Logic Design every Friday from 04:30 PM to 05:30 PM. Students who scored below 40% in internal diagnostic quizzes are required to attend. Attendance will be credited towards their overall record.

title: Tree Plantation Drive & Clean Green Campus Initiative
summary: Join the National Service Scheme in planting 500 indigenous saplings across the university perimeter.
content: In observance of World Environment Month, the NSS volunteer chapter invites all staff and students to take part in our Green CHARUSAT drive. Participants will receive social service credit hours and a certificate of commendation. Gathering point: University Main Circle, 08:00 AM.

title: Student Startup Prototype Grant: Call for Innovative Ideas (Batch 2026)
summary: Financial support up to ₹2.5 Lakhs per student team for developing hardware & software POCs.
content: Student innovators with viable prototypes addressing healthcare, smart agriculture, renewable energy, and artificial intelligence are invited to submit their venture proposals. Shortlisted teams will receive dedicated laboratory incubation, mentor guidance from industry CEOs, and patent filing assistance.
